snippet.title: Virtuoso Neomedia Black Voices in Gaming Showcase!
snippet.description:
Today we shared our recent works with BVIG for their Black History Month showcase! Meet our creative director Ethan Redd, and enjoy not 1 but 3 trailers of our recent announcements!

Virtuoso Neomedia is dedicated to creating bold, optimistic, fun-forward new hits for a new generation! We're fully independent, so if you like what you see and our vision resonates with you please support our released titles and follow our social media for updates. Thank you!
